prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. Create a single ultra-wide, slim editorial header banner for a premium head spa treatment menu, approximately 2400 x 400 pixels, aspect ratio 6:1. Warm ivory and muted oatmeal linen background with very subtle real woven texture. On the extreme left edge only, a carefully cropped cream ceramic bowl and folded natural linen; on the extreme right edge only, a few soft olive botanical leaves and a small cropped amber glass bottle. Quiet warm daylight, tactile and understated, no people, no busy decor. The center two thirds is mostly clean warm ivory negative space. Center the exact word "Menu" in large elegant deep navy blue (#173f5f) classic book serif lettering inspired by Libre Baskerville, regular weight, very legible, no script. Text centered horizontally and vertically, occupying about half the banner height. Only text is "Menu", capital M lowercase enu. All essential text must fit within the central 30 percent of the width and central 50 percent of height so it survives responsive cropping. The image is a tasteful slim website divider/header, not a tall hero, not a framed card, no logo, no border, no watermark, no additional text. Match a countryside cottage spa brand with warm editorial photography, muted cream surfaces and navy typography.
display: Centered crop for slim desktop header; wider image visible on mobile. Accessible HTML heading accompanies raster Menu text.
